traps.description: "Save up to 42%" is a discount percentage, not a price.
Partner discounts (20% on PandaDoc and CloudTalk, 15% on Surfe) are other vendors’ products.
The annual total (e.g. US$ 168) must not be presented as a monthly price.
US$14 belongs to Lite, not Growth.

ignorable.description: Other add-ons ("Starting from $16" etc.) are true but not enumerated.

notes: Card layout: each price, its unit and its billing note sit on separate lines, and the plan name is a plain line (not a heading). Prices are written US$ (explicit USD). The headline monthly figure ("US$14") is monthly-billed-annually; the verifiable annual total sits on its own line ("One payment of US$ 168 per seat/year").
